Kits / Desktop / Stack-chan
N° 16 — Desktop companion robotApache-2.0
Kit for

Stack-chan

Open-source design: Shinya Ishikawa (meganetaaan) and community

Small desktop companion whose face is drawn on an M5Stack module display. Two servos pan and tilt the head; behaviour is programmed in JavaScript or with blocks right in the browser.

05 — Project, licence, safetyLicence and safety+

This kit is based on the open project Stack-chan, created by Shinya Ishikawa (meganetaaan) and community. The design files are published under Apache-2.0, the software under Apache-2.0.

printedrobotics.cz prints the parts and assembles the kit from the bill of materials of Stack-chan. The project’s authors are not affiliated with us and have not endorsed this product.

Safety notice

Not a toy. Contains small parts — choking hazard.

For ages 14 and up; younger children only under adult supervision. Moving parts can pinch fingers.
Charge lithium batteries only with a suitable charger, supervised and away from flammable objects; never use a damaged cell.
Power the hardware in this kit only from the supply specified in the project instructions.

Kit manufacturer

printedrobotics.cz, Prague. Full manufacturer details and the declaration of conformity will be published before sales begin.
